user.title: Collection location
user.description: Where should collections be searched? You can add more instances to watch several areas, and change this later via "Configure".

menu_options.home: Home location (follows the home set in Home Assistant)
menu_options.entity: A zone, person or tracker (position followed)

entity.title: Follow an entity
entity.description: Searches around the chosen entity's position and refreshes when it moves more than 3 km (at most every 10 minutes). A zone gives a fixed point; a person or tracker, a moving one.

data_description.inclure_professionnelles: Often restricted to staff or students.
data_description.max_collectes: Capped at 30 to stay under the recorder's 16 kB attribute limit.
data_description.intervalle_minutes: Seat counts change quickly: 60 min is a good trade-off.

error.invalid_postal_code: The postal code must have 5 digits.
error.unknown_postal_code: No municipality found for this postal code.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the Géo API (geo.api.gouv.fr).
error.entity_no_location: This entity does not currently report a position (latitude and longitude).

abort.already_configured: An instance already watches this location.
abort.no_home_location: The home location is not set in Home Assistant.

location.description: Current location: **{lieu}**. Entity IDs do not change: dashboards and automations keep working.
